preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S_i <= 2 * 10**5 for S_i in S)
preconditions.description: Each element in the set S is between 1 and 200,000.
The number of elements in the set S matches the given n.

postconditions.description: The largest non-negative integer x is between 0 and 18.
The length of the magical permutation is 2^x.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= p < 2**x for p in permutation)
postconditions.description: Each element in the magical permutation is between 0 and 2^x - 1.

postconditions.expression: all((permutation[i] ^ permutation[i+1]) in S for i in range(2**x - 1))
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of any two consecutive elements in the permutation is an element in S.
